'''Illodia sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that was located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" /> 

[[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Illodia]] itself as well as twenty proud and semi-independent Illodian colonies.<ref name="TEA" />

Illodia sector was represented in both the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] and the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by [[Doman Beruss (Illodian)|Doman Beruss]].
